intro: Support Tunbridge Wells and Rusthall Commons. Join as an annual member from £10/year, make a Gift-Aided donation, join practical conservation volunteering sessions, or pledge to the community purchase.

membership_tiers.name: Individual Member
membership_tiers.description: Essential annual support to protect ancient woodland, clear historic paths, and maintain 256 acres of common land.
benefits: 1 vote at the Charity's Annual General Meeting (AGM)
Support practical conservation sessions and tools
Directly safeguards 256 acres of historic landscape
Regular newsletters and guided walk invitations

membership_tiers.name: Family / Household
membership_tiers.description: Covers all adults living at the same address, demonstrating united household support.
benefits: Two votes at the Charity's Annual General Meeting (AGM)
Household support for practical conservation and equipment
Strengthens community backing for our freehold acquisition bid
United household commitment to protecting 256 acres

bacs_notice.heading: Paying by direct bank transfer?
bacs_notice.text: Please let us know your details so we can allocate your membership and register your Gift Aid.

volunteer_opportunities.title: Practical Conservation Volunteer Morning
volunteer_opportunities.description: Organised by the Commons Conservators & Ranger team and supported by The Friends. Open to all with no prior experience required.

volunteer_opportunities.title: Litter Clearance Sessions
volunteer_opportunities.description: Community-led clean up walks keeping footpaths, sandstone rocks, and glades free from rubbish.
